notes.title: Chessie Chicken MAJOR Update! New levels & additional features!
notes.notes:
Chessie Chicken has 3 amazing updates.

-3 new worlds. (15 additional boards + 3 boss levels)
-NEW FEATURE: Chess pieces now move, offering a new dimension to gameplay.
-New gameplay mode, "Move or Fry": Move to a safe square before the Chess pieces attack!
Compete on Steam Leaderboards for the best time.

Small changes/fixes:

-Player can now see where Chess pieces can attack momentarily while receiving damage.
-Adjusted timer mechanic.  There is no longer a time constraint.  If the timer runs out, instead of losing the level, no bonus points are received.
-Errors are now counted by how many times you are hit and are no longer uniquely counted once per square.

notes.title: Update 4/2/2022
notes.notes:
Made the first few levels easier.  Was receiving feedback about game being too difficult at the start.

Also added a Chess piece move key on the main UI.
